Fixed. In `axum/src/routing/mod.rs`:

- Removed the trailing-slash redirect logic in `Router::call` (axum/src/routing/mod.rs:884): `MatchError::MissingTrailingSlash` and `ExtraTrailingSlash` now fall through to the fallback (404) like `NotFound`.
- Deleted the now-unused `replace_path` helper and its test, plus unused imports (`Redirect`, `Uri`, `IntoResponse`).

Verification: `cargo test -p axum --all-features` — all 203 lib + 108 integration tests pass, including `not_found_for_extra_trailing_slash`, `not_found_for_missing_trailing_slash`, and `with_and_without_trailing_slash`.
